name: Semi-Supervised Split-Bag Pre-Adapted Gigapixel Tile MIL
summary: We represent each patient by six clinical variables (with explicit missing levels) and Virchow2 plus H-Optimus-1 tile bags. Inside every fold, we apply PCA and pretrain a multihead attention aggregator via self-supervised split-bag agreement across training and 259 unlabelled patients before balanced multimodal fine-tuning. Repeated nested patient cross-validation, inner benchmarking against simple_reference, and a 19-site audit control overfitting and confounding. The paired 95% bootstrap macro-F1 interval determines whether H&E improves PAM50 prediction.
preprocessing: Pool all slides and up to 128 aligned tiles per slide into one bag per patient ID (keeping all slides of the 46 multi-slide patients together); strip any RNA-derived columns and exclude collection site from all model inputs (A1, A2, D5, D6).

Inside each training split (inner, outer, and site-held-out), fit identical clinical transformations for floor_clinical, simple_reference, and ssl_preadapted_mil: z-score age using training-split statistics and one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 with an explicit missing_or_indeterminate level (A3, D2).

Inside each training split, L2-normalise tile vectors per encoder and fit randomized PCA (dim=128) strictly on tiles from that split's labelled training patients plus the 259 unlabelled patients, projecting validation tiles without accessing held-out patients or labels (A4, D3).
Verify baseline sanity and strict modality isolation on a pilot split for floor_clinical and simple_reference prior to full nested cross-validation execution (K8).

training.ssl_split_cache: Run Stage-1 split-bag consistency pre-adaptation (two disjoint random 32-tile sub-bags per patient) once per fold training split on labelled-train plus 259 unlabelled bags, then evaluate Stage-2 supervised configurations.
training.convergence_criterion: Record per-epoch Stage-1 consistency loss and Stage-2 class-balanced cross-entropy loss in every fold; confirm trailing 5-epoch mean loss change is <2% of total fold loss reduction before reading scores (A6, K3).

validation.tie_and_simplicity_rule: Treat inner-fold macro-F1 differences <0.005 as ties in favour of stronger regularisation (K1); adopt ssl_preadapted_mil over fold-matched simple_reference in outer fold only when inner-fold macro-F1 strictly exceeds simple_reference (A5), while also archiving ungated ssl_preadapted_mil OOF predictions.
validation.site_held_out_sensitivity: 19-split Leave-One-Site-Out cross-validation grouped strictly by collection site (never using site as a predictor), pooling out-of-site predictions across all 802 labelled patients to compute paired macro-F1 difference against site-held-out floor_clinical (D4, K9).
validation.bootstrap_details: 10,000 patient-level cluster bootstrap resamples of the 802 labelled patients across paired repeat-wise out-of-fold predictions to compute the 95% confidence interval (A7, D8).

metrics: Paired out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) with 95% patient-level bootstrap confidence interval
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Per-class out-of-fold recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and minority Her2
Site-held-out paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) pooled across the 19 collection sites
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference on identical folds
allowed_conclusions: Map the 95% patient-level bootstrap CI for paired macro-F1 difference strictly to: 'improves' (lower bound > 0), 'insufficient evidence' (interval contains 0), or 'worse' (upper bound < 0), scoped solely to incremental patient-level PAM50 prediction over clinical plus IHC variables in this TCGA-BRCA cohort and contextualised by 19-site LOSO sensitivity without claiming standalone H&E utility or causal biology.

diversity.data: clinical + Virchow2/H-Optimus-1 tile bags across labelled-train and 259 unlabelled patients (fold-PCA)
diversity.model: self-supervised split-bag pre-adapted gated multihead-attention MIL (ssl_preadapted_mil)
diversity.method: fold-internal unlabelled+train split-bag consistency pretraining + balanced early-concat fine-tuning with A5 gating

rationale: Supervised tile attention on high-dimensional ViTs easily overfits 65 Her2 cases and outlier tiles (D1, D3, D6). Split-bag self-supervision across training and 259 unlabelled patients learns reproducible tumour morphology without labels. Joint concatenation with missing-explicit receptors compensates when HER2 immunohistochemistry is equivocal (D2, D7).
